Bulgarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

внук (vnuk) +‎ -ка (-ka)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈvnut͡ʃkɐ]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ut͡ʃkɐ
  • Syllabification(key): внуч‧ка

Noun

[edit]

вну́чка • (vnúčka) f

  1. granddaughter
